v10 raw + WaterRouter snap-only post-processor (no retraining). NEW BEST WATER-STRICT model. ADE 7934m vs v10+hard-proj 9345m (15% improvement) AND land% 0.09 (vs hard-proj 0.02) at threshold 10km — both satisfy strict-water gate. Long-bucket: 25441m vs hard-proj 44230m (42% reduction). Two-stage snap: detect on-land via coarse 0.05° SDF >threshold_km, then snap to nearest connected fine-grid 0.005° water cell (~0.5km precision vs hard-proj's 5km). require_connected (neighbor_bits>0) avoids landlocked-inlet traps. Verifies snap satisfies coarse threshold; if not, retries with min_clearance_km. Pass-gate: ADE 7934 missed 7000 target by 13%, traj_cross 1.2% missed 0.1% target (segment-bridge mode hurt ADE more than it fixed crossings). Engineering only, ~6h dev time. Best for production: v10_router (snap-only). Best for ADE without water-strict constraint: v9 ep38 (6207m, but 12.8% land cross).
